court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Family Court, Hathras, Case No.626 of 2021
case_name: Smt. Sweta Singh vs Manoj Kumar
facts_of_case: The applicant is the wife and opposite party is the husband. Proceeding under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act has been initiated at the instance of the opposite party/husband in the Family Court, Hathras.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish a prima facie case for transfer of proceedings.
legal_principles.held: I have considered the argument advanced by learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer proceedings under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act if it is difficult for a party to attend court proceedings due to distance.
legal_principles.held: There is no dispute about the fact that the proceeding under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act is pending before Family Court, Hathras.

outcome.final_order: The proceeding under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act was transferred from the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Hathras to Principle Judge, Family Court, Moradabad.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
